newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU acts against member states on trade barriers.
newsitem.headline: EU acts against member states on trade barriers.

text.p: The European Commission, determined to enforce rules governing the European Union's internal market, decided on Tuesday to take action against five member states for blocking the free movement of goods.
The EU executive said it would send so called reasoned opinions -- the second stage in EU infringement proceedings -- to France, Italy, Belgium, Germany and Spain.
It accused them of violating article 30 of the EU treaty, which bans quantitative restrictions on imports between member states or other measures having the same effect.

The cases concern barriers to imports of alcoholic drinks and rubber products in contact with foodstuffs to France, tow bars to Italy, nutrient enriched foodstuffs to Belgium, dietary products for infants to Germany, and foodstuffs containing additives and tea to Spain.

The Commission -- acting in response to complaints -- can take the matter to the European Court of Justice if it has not received what it considers to be a satisfactory answer from the member states concerned within two months . -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800 Fredrik Dahl
